title: NITDA | Unified Operations Hub
purpose: Single-file operations hub for NITDA's Digital Governance Office that handles compliance task acknowledgement (deep-link target), a task dashboard with quick-create, an omni-mode repository search across documents/tasks/emails, directive assignment with category-driven assignee suggestion, and email-to-task conversion. Calls multiple Power Automate flows directly and supports an embedded iframe shell signaling/theming protocol.

offerings.name: Task Acknowledgement
offerings.description: Standalone acknowledgement screen reached via ?taskId deep link; records confirmation with device/user-agent for audit and posts to the (placeholder) acknowledge flow.

offerings.name: Compliance Task Dashboard
offerings.description: Lists active tasks fetched from the GET flow and provides a fast-track quick-create input for new compliance tasks.

offerings.name: Omni-Mode Repository Search
offerings.description: Unified search across Documents, Tasks, and Emails selectable by a type dropdown, rendering type-specific result cards with action buttons.

offerings.name: Directive Assignment
offerings.description: Form to assign a selected document to a responsible person with category/sub-category lookups, suggested department/assignee, priority and comments; submits to the create flow.

offerings.name: Email-to-Task Conversion
offerings.description: Converts a searched email into a compliance task, prefilling a generated title and showing sanitized email body, then submits to the create flow.

offerings.name: Task Progress Update
offerings.description: Modal to update an existing task's status and post a progress note via the create flow.

views.name: screen-landing
views.trigger: navigateTo('landing') when no nitda_session in sessionStorage

views.name: screen-tasks
views.trigger: navigateTo('tasks') nav-item; no matching screen-tasks element exists

js_utilities.name: navigateTo
js_utilities.purpose: Router: toggles .active on screen-{viewId} and nav items, sets currentView, lazy-loads dashboard tasks or lookups.

js_utilities.name: callAPI
js_utilities.purpose: Core fetch engine: dedupes in-flight requests, shows/hides loader, POSTs JSON with userEmail+timestamp, returns parsed data or null on error.

js_utilities.name: showLoader
js_utilities.purpose: Sets loader text and shows global loader overlay.

js_utilities.name: hideLoader
js_utilities.purpose: Hides global loader overlay.

js_utilities.name: bootApp
js_utilities.purpose: Reads auth email/name, stores session, hydrates UI and processes deep link.

js_utilities.name: hydrateUI
js_utilities.purpose: Populates header user display, initials, and role from AppState.user.

js_utilities.name: processDeepLink
js_utilities.purpose: Parses URL params taskId/view to route to ack, an explicit view, or dashboard.

js_utilities.name: executeAcknowledge
js_utilities.purpose: Posts taskId+device userAgent to API_ACK, then marks badge/button as acknowledged.

js_utilities.name: loadDashboardTasks
js_utilities.purpose: Fetches tasks via API_GET and renders task rows with status badges.

js_utilities.name: quickCreateTask
js_utilities.purpose: Creates a task from dashboard input via API_CREATE then reloads list.

js_utilities.name: fetchLookups
js_utilities.purpose: Fetches reference lookups (categories/departments/users) and populates assign category dropdown.

js_utilities.name: runOmniSearch
js_utilities.purpose: Selects DOCS/TASKS/EMAILS endpoint by type, queries, and renders results.

js_utilities.name: renderOmniResults
js_utilities.purpose: Renders type-specific result cards (doc/task/email) with inline onclick action buttons.

js_utilities.name: openAssignForm
js_utilities.purpose: Sets selection.doc, fills assign banner/ref and navigates to assign screen.

js_utilities.name: onAssignCatChange
js_utilities.purpose: Populates subcategory list and suggests default responsible department/assignee email from lookups.

js_utilities.name: submitFullAssignment
js_utilities.purpose: Validates and posts a singleassignment payload to API_CREATE; alerts and returns to dashboard.

js_utilities.name: openEmailToTaskForm
js_utilities.purpose: Prefills email-to-task form title and preview body, navigates to conversion screen.

js_utilities.name: submitEmailToTask
js_utilities.purpose: Posts converted email-to-task payload to API_CREATE then returns to dashboard.

js_utilities.name: openTaskUpdate
js_utilities.purpose: Sets selection.task, presets modal status and shows task update modal.

js_utilities.name: closeModal
js_utilities.purpose: Removes .show from a modal overlay.

js_utilities.name: executeTaskUpdate
js_utilities.purpose: Posts updateTask payload to API_CREATE, closes modal and re-runs omni search.

js_utilities.name: initShell
js_utilities.purpose: If embedded in an iframe, listens for NITDA_SHELL postMessage (THEME_CHANGE) and announces MODULE_READY to parent.

dom_contract.notes: Heavy use of inline style attributes throughout markup and template literals. Screens toggled via .screen/.active. A 'tasks' nav item exists with no corresponding screen-tasks element.

event_handling.notes: Almost all interactivity is via inline onclick/onkeydown/onchange attributes; postMessage listener bound only inside initShell IIFE when window !== window.parent. Generated result cards embed JSON.stringify(item) into inline onclick handlers.

global_scope.notes: NITDA_CONFIG and AppState are module-scoped const at top of the single script. window.onload assigned. initShell is an IIFE not exposed globally.

state_management: Single mutable AppState const object holds user, currentView, tasks array, lookups (categories/departments/users), selection (doc/task/email), isDeepLink flag, and an _fetching map used to dedupe concurrent requests per endpoint. User identity persisted in sessionStorage under key 'nitda_session'. No reactive framework; DOM updated imperatively via innerHTML and direct element mutation.

design_tokens.spacing_or_layout_notes: CSS custom properties under :root with a [data-theme=dark] override block. --radius 12px, --shadow soft green-tinted, --transition 0.2s ease. Max content width 1100px; sticky header (64px) and nav strip; screens animate with fadeIn keyframe.

power_automate_flows.name: API_GET (getTasks)
power_automate_flows.response_shape: Array of tasks OR { data: [tasks] } with fields title/Title, ID, assignedTo/AssignedTo, status
power_automate_flows.error_handling: Try/catch in callAPI hides loader, console.error, returns null; empty render fallback message.

power_automate_flows.name: API_CREATE (create/assign/convert/update)
power_automate_flows.trigger: quickCreateTask, submitFullAssignment (action singleassignment), submitEmailToTask, executeTaskUpdate (action updateTask)
power_automate_flows.request_shape: Varies by caller; e.g. { title, createdBy } | { action:'singleassignment', docId, title, category, subCategory, assignee, priority, comments, createdBy } | { title, assignee, priority, notes, emailId, createdBy } | { action:'updateTask', taskId, status, note, updatedBy }; plus userEmail+timestamp auto-merged.
power_automate_flows.response_shape: Truthy response object on success (used only as boolean gate); alerts on success.
power_automate_flows.error_handling: callAPI try/catch returns null; submitFullAssignment only proceeds if res truthy.

power_automate_flows.name: API_ACK (acknowledge)
power_automate_flows.response_shape: Unused; UI updates badge/button regardless of response value.
power_automate_flows.error_handling: Placeholder endpoint (YOUR_FLOW_URL); UI marks acknowledged even if call fails/returns null.

power_automate_flows.name: LOOKUPS
power_automate_flows.trigger: fetchLookups() on first navigation to omni view
power_automate_flows.error_handling: callAPI try/catch; only populates if res.data present.

power_automate_flows.name: DOCS (search)
power_automate_flows.response_shape: Array or { data } of documents with Title, ID, Status, Category
power_automate_flows.error_handling: callAPI try/catch; empty result renders 'No matching records found.'

power_automate_flows.name: TASKS (search)
power_automate_flows.response_shape: Array or { data } of tasks with Title, ID, Progress, AssignedTo
power_automate_flows.error_handling: callAPI try/catch; empty result renders fallback message.

power_automate_flows.name: EMAILS (search)
power_automate_flows.response_shape: Array or { data } of emails with subject, fromName/fromAddress, bodyContent/bodyPreview, id
power_automate_flows.error_handling: callAPI try/catch; empty result renders fallback message.

behaviors.notes: Global loader overlay with spinner shown during every callAPI; per-endpoint in-flight dedupe via AppState._fetching. Dashboard shows static 'Polling for updates...' placeholder text but there is no actual polling/setInterval. Errors are swallowed (console.error + null return); minimal user-facing error UI beyond empty-state messages.

accessibility.notes: No ARIA roles/attributes. Keyboard support limited to Enter-to-search on the omni query input via onkeydown. Inputs have visible labels but no programmatic associations beyond proximity.

localization.notes: html lang='en'; all copy hard-coded in English. Emoji used as visual category markers in option labels.

risks_and_quirks: Live Power Automate SAS tokens (sig=...) were hard-coded in NITDA_CONFIG for 6 of 7 endpoints; redacted here.
API_ACK endpoint is an unconfigured placeholder 'https://YOUR_FLOW_URL/acknowledge'; acknowledgement UI succeeds regardless of network outcome.
Generated result cards embed JSON.stringify(item) directly into inline onclick handlers (openAssignForm/openTaskUpdate/openEmailToTaskForm) - potential breakage/XSS if data contains quotes or script.
Email body injected via innerHTML in et-preview-content with no sanitization despite 'Sanitized' label.
'My Tasks' nav item routes to view 'tasks' but no screen-tasks element exists (dead navigation).
Errors are silently swallowed (returns null) so failed loads look like empty inventories.
Auth is purely client-side trust (email+name stored in sessionStorage); no real authentication.
No request timeout/abort; long flows could hang the loader indefinitely.
